title: SSTWL - Sector Breach
description:
SSTWL: Sector Breach is a point and click survival-horror game revolving the characters and world created by Liam Vickers throughout the “Scary Story Time With Liam” YouTube channel.

 

Drink your coffee, recover the files, and fend off everything that goes bump in the night. It’s only six hours, what’s the worst that could happen? It’s not like the fate of the universe is at stake, right?

As a FNaF-like, Sector Breach borrows many core aspects of those games mechanics; Sit in your office, watch cameras, close doors, etc. But of course, it’s not that simple.

Use the camera lights to keep the monsters blind and disoriented, just don’t flash the wrong one. Keep your head on a swivel, don’t let what’s in the monitor distract you from what’s in your doorway. Most importantly, recover the Data Files. They are why you are here. The fate of humanity depends upon it.

The game’s story is designed to not only tie into established lore and plot lines of the SSTWL channel, but also act as a way for new fans to jump into the lore of everyone’s favorite niche internet creepypasta author.

Sector Breach is a love letter to all the incredible stories Liam Vickers has written, and the amazing community which has continued to flourish around them even all these years later. <3
description_short: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.
